title: Route to Remember: Adaptive Memory Selection for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.05636v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The memory of production agents is increasingly becoming a bottleneck and is built almost exclusively from text: key points are extracted from out-of-limit context and retrieved into context at query time. Therefore, every new query incurs an additional cost that grows with the accumulated history. Weight memory is a complementary alternative that internalizes knowledge into model parameters and answers with no context at all, and has recently proven effective in self-evolving agents for internalizing skills and behaviors. However, its application in episodic and semantic memory, such as user-specific facts, remains comparatively unexplored, and a gap remains between earlier attempts at weight memory and text-based systems regarding recall performance. translated_title: 记忆之路：面向大语言模型智能体的自适应记忆选择
translated_abstract: 生产级智能体的记忆正日益成为瓶颈，而且其记忆几乎完全由文本构成：从超出上下文限制的内容中提取要点，并在查询时检索回上下文中。因此，每个新查询都会产生随累积历史增长而不断增加的额外成本。权重记忆是一种互补的替代方案，它将知识内化到模型参数中，可以在完全没有上下文的情况下进行回答，并且最近已在自进化智能体中证明能够有效内化技能与行为。然而，权重记忆在情景记忆和语义记忆（如用户特定事实）方面的应用仍相对缺乏探索，且早期的权重记忆尝试与基于文本的记忆系统在召回性能上仍存在差距。我们研究了如何通过在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）使权重记忆成为一种有竞争力的长期事实存储方法。该方法从一个教师模型训练出无上下文的学生模型，该教师是……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出利用在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）将用户特定事实等知识内化到模型参数中的权重记忆方法，并自适应地在文本记忆与权重记忆之间进行路由选择，使权重记忆作为长期事实存储在召回性能上可与基于文本的记忆系统相媲美，从而消除随历史累积而增长的查询开销。
en_tdlr: This paper applies on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) to internalize episodic and semantic facts into model parameters as weight memory, and adaptively routes between text-based and weight-based memory, making weight memory competitive with text-based systems as a long-term factual store while eliminating query-time costs that grow with accumulated history.
